heroes:
Create a genuine sequential animation sprite sheet, not a character design lineup. Use the attached image ONLY as character identity and painted art-style reference. Preserve exactly the same character, costume, weapons, proportions and colors in EVERY frame. Output PORTRAIT 1536x2048 with EXACTLY FOUR equal-width columns and SIX equal-height rows: 24 cells total. Each cell contains one complete isolated full-body sprite on REAL TRANSPARENT alpha, no ground, no shadow, no background, no text, labels, borders, guides or numbers. Character faces RIGHT in strict side / slight three-quarter game view. Identical camera, scale, hip anchor and floor baseline in all cells, generous transparent margins especially for weapon tips. Character height about 250 pixels inside each 384x341 cell. Fine ink outlines, readable cel shading, hand-painted fantasy arcade sprite art. The 24 frames are read LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM. ROW 1 = FOUR idle-breathing frames: neutral, inhale, exhale, return. ROWS 2 AND 3 = EIGHT consecutive RUN frames forming one full smooth looping stride: left foot forward contact, left foot weight-down right leg lifting, passing position right knee forward, airborne high stride, RIGHT foot forward contact, right foot weight-down left leg lifting, passing position left knee forward, airborne returning to first pose. The two legs MUST visibly alternate, the entire silhouette and cape must change with the stride; no repeated static stances. ROWS 4 AND 5 = EIGHT consecutive frames of ONE melee attack: guard, drawn-back anticipation, acceleration, weapon CONTACT fully extended forwards, follow-through across body, settle, recovery, return to guard. Arms, shoulders, torso and weapon move substantially and progressively; blade/mace follows one clear arc. ROW 6 = FOUR secondary action frames as specified below. No giant baked effect covering the body; small weapon glow only. Do not alter the character design between frames. Crisp clean alpha edges. All twenty-four figures must fit their individual cells and be distinct sequential animation drawings.
Character: THOLGRIN, the reference stocky male DWARF, thick auburn beard, silver full plate armor with gold engraved trim, red tabard and red cape, round gold sacred shield on left arm, heavy mace in right hand. ROW 6 secondary: raises sacred shield in front, crouches behind shield, raises flaming mace to invoke fire, returns to guard. Preserve dwarf's face and plate design.
